newsitem.title: UK: Unilever shares off in profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Unilever shares off in profit-taking.

text.p: A strong run by Unilever shares came to a halt on Tuesday as a bout of profit-taking and an SBC Warburg "trading sell" recommendation hit the stock, dealers said.
After climbing to a new high of 16.42 stg, the shares changed direction and were six pence lower at 15.985 by 1338 GMT.
Market sources said SBC Warburg had recommended locking in profits after the stock's recent strong run.
"They've done exceptionally well over the last week and people are finally taking profits," one market-maker said. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
